skills.name: smartreply-account
skills.description: Manage a SmartReply AI customer service agent through its MCP tools. Use when the user wants to set up or troubleshoot SmartReply, automate or fix replies to social media comments and customer messages, moderate comments, import FAQs, change agent instructions or routing rules, test replies in the sandbox, search customer conversations, pause automatic replies, handle escalations, or approve or decline refunds, replacements, and other pending actions.
skills.description_zh: 通过 MCP 管理 SmartReply AI 客服，涵盖接入排障、社交评论和消息自动回复、审核、FAQ、指令路由、沙箱测试、会话搜索、暂停自动回复、升级及退款换货等待处理动作批准或拒绝。
